newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac cuts variable mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac cuts variable mortgage rate.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Monday it would reduce its variable home loan interest rates to 7.55 percent from 8.25 percent previously.
The rate change takes effect from February 19 for new customers and April 4 for existing customers.
Westpac also said it had reduced its First Option home loan to 6.95 percent from 7.29 percent. First Option will include both redraw and additional repayment facilities, it said.
The rate cut brings Westpac into line with the other "big four" banks after the Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd made a similar reduction earlier on Monday.
The Commonwealth Bank of Australia and National Australia Bank Ltd cut their rates last week.
